rationale: The agent verified the user via matching email and correctly identified the three pending orders. It updated only eligible (pending) orders to the Washington, DC address found on file and provided accurate final information. However, per policy the agent must state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation before performing any order-changing write. The agent executed the address updates immediately after the user’s request without an explicit confirmation step summarizing the changes, which violates the confirmation requirement. No other policy breaches (e.g., wrong account, fabricated info) are evident.
